patches_added.name: Flick Keys for Symbols
patches_added.description: Turn on Gboard's "Flick keys to enter symbols" — pull down on a key to enter the symbol hinted in its corner. Written once as a default, so it can still be turned off in Gboard's own settings.

patches_added.name: Select All Button
patches_added.description: Add a Select all button to the toolbar above the keyboard. One tap selects everything in the text field, without opening Gboard's text editing panel first.

patches_added.name: Swipe to Delete
patches_added.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches_removed.name: Grammar Check Row
patches_removed.description: Force the grammar check settings row to appear. The Phenotype flag that governs it never syncs on a patched build, so its compiled-in default (off) sticks.

patches_removed.name: Suggested Settings
patches_removed.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings.

patches_removed.name: Swipe Left to Delete
patches_removed.description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's own word-scrub engine, so it behaves exactly like swiping on the backspace key already does — only it can start anywhere.

patches_removed.name: Text Action Buttons
patches_removed.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists.

patches_removed.name: Toolbar Hotkeys
patches_removed.description: Adds six configurable hotkey slots to Gboard's toolbar — each commits a text of your choice on tap. A slot appears when its text is set; when cleared it hides at the next toolbar rebuild (rotate, switch IME, or restart — there's no mid-session un-register). Text and icon edits apply on the next keyboard open.

patches_removed.name: Vibration slider everywhere
patches_removed.description: Forces Gboard to show its own vibration strength slider on every device, rather than deferring to the system haptic settings page, so the strength is adjustable instead of being fixed by whichever rollout the device landed in.

patches_modified.name: Bigger Toolbar
patches_modified.description: Makes the number of icons on the toolbar above the keyboard adjustable, from Gboard's own settings. Anything past the limit stays in the overflow menu.

patches_modified.name: Swipe Right to Undo
patches_modified.description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.

patches_modified.name: Block Vivaldi Sync
patches_modified.description: Redirects bifrost.vivaldi.com to 0.0.0.0 in libchrome.so to completely disable Vivaldi account synchronization for an air-gapped experience.

patches_modified.name: Block Vivaldi Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Blocks Vivaldi usage statistics, crash reporting, Crashpad endpoints, and DirectMatch suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Clean Speed Dial Bookmarks
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored commercial affiliate bookmarks, hides the 3-dot customize button, and disables phantom touch actions on the blank Start Page.

patches_modified.name: Close Tabs on Exit
patches_modified.description: Prevents tab restoration on startup, ensuring Vivaldi always opens with a clean Start Page session regardless of how the app was terminated.

patches_modified.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches_modified.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by neutralizing periodic and one-shot background sync tasks.

patches_modified.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes the Android BatteryStatusManager broadcast listener to prevent continuous OS battery wakeups.

patches_modified.name: Disable Chromium Tips & Notification Scheduler
patches_modified.description: Eliminates periodic background wakeups, native library loading, and in-product promotional tips from Chromium tips scheduler.

patches_modified.name: Disable Vivaldi Prompts & In-App Popups
patches_modified.description: Disables in-app donation prompts, search engine switch promos, rate-app popups, background privacy report alarms, and default browser promotional handlers.

patches_modified.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

patches_modified.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches_modified.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches_modified.name: Resource Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips bundled stock wallpapers and sponsored Speed Dial thumbnails to reduce APK size.

patches_modified.name: Skip First Run
patches_modified.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches_modified.name: Vivaldi Startup Performance Optimization
patches_modified.description: Optimizes cold startup time, eliminates background CPU/disk overhead, and guards against early CompositorView LayoutStateObserver crashes.
